finding: Low blood chloride levels were identified as a potential predictor for the development of malignant tachypnea in infants with retained fetal lung fluid syndrome.
mod_finding: Infants with retained fetal lung fluid syndrome who were delivered by elective cesarean section had prolonged pneumothorax, pulmonary hypertension, antibiotic use frequency, and hospitalization periods.
